Attached: 1 image

📋 Open-source task and project manager tududi v2.1.0 is out.

What's new in this release:
✨ Quarterly roadmap timeline across areas, projects, and tasks
📊 Dedicated timeline tab on areas and a new summary row on projects

This update will be available on PikaPods in a few days.

Release notes: https://github.com/chrisvel/tududi/releases/tag/v2.1.0
Run on PikaPods: https://pikapods.com/pods?run=tududi

#opensource #ownyourdata
